note: A write edge names the ROUTINE, and the routine is not a fine enough answer to 'what activates this device' - survey routines run to a median of 4 rungs but p90 29 and max 68. Valve_Open here is written on rung 1 (OTE) and again on rung 3 (OTU). Edges dedupe on (source, target, kind), so those two writes collapse into ONE writes edge and the rung is unrecoverable from the edge alone: that is precisely why the adapter also emits rung-level references. Seq_Active is written on rung 0 and read on rung 1, so it carries both an edge and two references at different rungs. Step is read TWICE inside rung 2 - once as EQU's SourceA and once as MOV's Source - and dedupes to one reference, because a tag touched twice in one rung is one place to look and reference counts feed density scoring. The 3 in EQU(Step,3) is a literal and the Dest of MOV is a write, so Step_Last is written and never read. This file scores the symbols and edges; the reference assertions the fixture exists for live in tests/test_l5x_adapter.py, because the ADR-008 harness compares symbols and edges only.
